retrievalProfile.description: A kitschy 1970s interior scene featuring a bed with a quilted headboard, vertical striped wallpaper, and a framed group portrait floating on the wall.

recipe.visualDefinition: A surrealist-leaning retro bedroom scene dominated by vertical grey and white stripes, featuring a white quilted headboard and a pink textured picture frame containing a group portrait. The composition is anchored by a bed in the lower right and a draped side table on the left, with vibrant pink script text floating in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The pink picture frame acts as a secondary focal point against the repetitive wallpaper stripes.
The white quilted headboard mirrors the texture of the draped side table.
The diagonal placement of the script text balances the heavy visual weight of the bed.
The group portrait inside the frame provides a human element to the inanimate interior.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The bed occupies the lower right third; the picture frame is centered horizontally but positioned in the upper middle; the side table is in the lower left.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The pink picture frame provides the strongest color contrast and central focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the pink frame, move down to the bed, then follow the diagonal script text back up to the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The striped wallpaper serves as textured negative space, filling the gaps between furniture and frames.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Neutral grey and white stripes provide the structural background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant bubblegum pink is used for the frame and typography to break the neutral palette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep blue and tan in the bedding provide grounded earthy tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background contrasted with high-saturation pink accents.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to muted 70s neutrals with one bright pop color

letterConstructionRules: Thick, rounded strokes with uniform weight
Exaggerated loops on ascenders and descenders
Letters are connected with fluid, rhythmic ligatures
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters feature large, circular flourishes
Lowercase 's' has a soft, bulbous bottom curve
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: The script is intended to stand alone as a decorative element against the geometric wallpaper.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy weight and rounded retro feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a 1970s bedroom interior with vertical grey and white striped wallpaper. Include a white quilted diamond-pattern headboard on the right and a white draped side table on the left. Place a thick, textured pink rectangular frame in the center of the wall containing a portrait of four people.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a bold, pink, rounded cursive script tilted 30 degrees upward in the top right corner, ensuring it overlaps the wallpaper and the top of the headboard.

verificationChecks: Is the wallpaper strictly vertical stripes?
Is the headboard quilted in a diamond pattern?
Is the text tilted upwards and colored bright pink?
Is there a distinct pink frame on the wall?

mustRedesign: Any brand logos in the top left corner

mustAchieve: Tactile texture on the headboard and frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pink frame looks like a physical object on the wall.
Check that the script text does not have a modern digital drop shadow.
Verify the side table looks like it is covered in a heavy, draped cloth.
Confirm the wallpaper stripes are perfectly vertical and uniform.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Vertical Striped Background] + [Quilted Furniture Element] + [Textured Pop-Color Frame] + [Diagonal Script Overlay] to recreate this retro-soul aesthetic.
